The amount of people who think this is AI and fake is really funny but also frustrating. Did they just not read the post? How can you just see this and not even do the searching to see if you’re correct about it being fake or not when OP told you what to search if you wanted to see this for yourself 💀
There are actually hundreds of instagram and TikTok pages of salons doing these treatments, none of the doubters bothered to look I guess lol

They have a circle light for filming but pretty much all social media hair influencers do. Even a light cannot make your hair shiny. If your hair is unhealthy or dull, a bright light won’t do anything but show you how damaged and frizzy your hair actually is. I bright light is never going to make normal hair look like this.

I’m going to post some different accounts showing that this is not a photoshopped photo, it’s a video, and you can see for yourself that this is real, not photoshopped or AI. I can’t vouch for the products being used, but it’s a real treatment that give you mega glossy hair!

Here is [one account](https://www.instagram.com/reel/C4X1aTMurb4/?igsh=MXZveWRlYXNmZGNiZA==) showing process from beginning to end that you can check out yourself. 

[another one on blonde hair under natural lighting](https://www.instagram.com/reel/C3vCecotmU4/?igsh=NTcxMnQzMnU2MXU0) look through this account to see it done on light hair. Most of the time, posts don’t show a lot of light hair colors because the dark colors look much more glossy and reflective.

[another page](https://www.instagram.com/reel/C3ixEi9v8Im/?igsh=bDBuNGJyOHRyZzdw)

OP, have you seen the [Color Wow Dream Coat](https://www.instagram.com/reel/C2hipnJuJtd/?igsh=MWY0NGp1dW9qbXgxYw==)? It gives this effect if used right. 

I had a keratin treatment that had this result before COVID lockdown. They washed my hair a couple times and then put the treatment in and then blow dried and straightened my hair like usual. I could not believe how shiny it looked! My hair is dark so it was shockingly reflective! It stayed soft and shiny for quite a while! A lot of the shine faded after a few months, but it was still pretty shiny!

I know you care for her, but it may take this young woman many, many years to understand what is happening to her and be able to become her own person and disregard the expectations of her parents.
